verses.heading: ALEPH
verses.text:
How she sits alone,
the city that was great with people!
She has become like a widow
who was great among the nations.
The princess among the provinces
has become a forced laborer.

verses.heading: BETH
verses.text:
She weeps bitterly in the night,
and her tears are on her cheeks.
She has no comforter
from all those who love her.
All her companions have betrayed her;
they have become enemies to her.

verses.heading: GIMEL
verses.text:
Judah has gone into exile
from affliction and from the greatness of forced labor.
She herself has settled among the nations;
she has not found a resting place.
All her pursuers have overtaken her
between the narrow passes.

verses.heading: DALETH
verses.text:
The roads of Zion are mourning
because no one is coming to the appointed feast.
All her gates are desolate;
her priests are groaning.
Her young women are grieving,
and it is bitter to her.

verses.heading: HE
verses.text:
Her adversaries have become the head;
her enemies are prospering,
for Yahweh has afflicted her
over the greatness of her transgressions.
Her children have gone away
as captives before the adversary.

verses.heading: WAW
verses.text:
And from the daughter of Zion
all her majesty has departed.
Her princes have become like deer
that have found no pasture.
And they have walked without strength
before the pursuer.

verses.heading: ZAYIN
verses.text:
Jerusalem remembered
in the days of her affliction and of her wanderings,
all her precious things
that were from the days of old.
When her people fell into the hand of the adversary
and there was no helper for her,
the adversaries saw her;
they laughed over her collapse.

verses.heading: HETH
verses.text:
Jerusalem has grievously sinned;
therefore she has become an abhorrence.
All who honored her have despised her,
because they have seen her nakedness.
And she herself has groaned
and turned backward.

verses.heading: TETH
YODH
verses.text:
The adversary has spread out his hand
over all her precious things,
for she has seen nations
entering her sanctuary—
those whom you commanded
should not enter your assembly.

verses.heading: KAPH
verses.text:
All her people are groaning,
seeking bread.
They have given their precious things for food
to restore life.
“See, Yahweh, and look,
for I have become despised.”

verses.heading: LAMEDH
verses.text:
“Is it nothing to you,
all you who pass along the way?
Look and see
if there is any pain like my pain
that has been done to me,
which Yahweh has inflicted
on the day of his burning anger.

verses.heading: MEM
verses.text:
From on high he sent fire
into my bones, and it ruled over them.
He spread a net for my feet;
he turned me back.
He made me desolate,
faint all the day.

verses.heading: NUN
SAMEKH
verses.text:
The Lord has rejected all the mighty men in my midst.
He has called an appointed time against me
to crush my young men.
The Lord has trodden the winepress
for the virgin daughter of Judah.

verses.heading: AYIN
verses.text:
Over these things I, I am weeping;
my eye, my eye is running down with water,
for a comforter who restores my life
is far from me.
My sons are desolate
because the enemy has prevailed.”

verses.heading: PE
verses.text:
Zion has spread out her hands;
there is no comforter for her.
Yahweh has commanded against Jacob
that his adversaries should be around him.
Jerusalem has become
an abhorrence among them.

verses.heading: TSADHE
verses.text:
“Yahweh is righteous,
for I have rebelled against his mouth.
Hear, please, all peoples,
and see my pain.
My young women and my young men
have gone into captivity.

verses.heading: QOPH
verses.text:
I called to those who love me;
they, they deceived me.
My priests and my elders
expired in the city,
when they were seeking food for themselves
to restore their life.

verses.heading: RESH
SIN
TAW
verses.text:
Let all their evil come before you,
and deal with them
as you have dealt with me
over all my transgressions,
for my groaning is many
and my heart is faint.”

verses.heading: ALEPH
verses.text:
How the Lord has covered with a cloud the daughter of Zion in his nose!
He has cast from heaven to earth the splendor of Israel,
and he did not remember the footstool of his feet on the day of his nose.

verses.heading: BETH
GIMEL
verses.text:
He has cut off in the burning of nose every horn of Israel.
He has turned back his right hand from the face of the enemy,
and he burned in Jacob like a fire of flame consuming all around.

verses.heading: DALETH
verses.text:
He has bent his bow like an enemy;
his right hand is stationed like an adversary,
and he has slain all the delights of the eye.
In the tent of the daughter of Zion,
he has poured out his anger like fire.

verses.heading: HE
WAW
verses.text:
And he has done violence like to his garden booth;
he has destroyed his appointed place.
Yahweh has caused people in Zion to forget appointed festival and Sabbath,
and he has despised king and priest in the indignation of his nose.

verses.heading: ZAYIN
verses.text:
The Lord has rejected his altar;
he has abhorred his sanctuary.
He has delivered up into the hand of the enemy
the walls of her palaces.
They raised a shout in the house of Yahweh
as on the day of an appointed festival.

verses.heading: HETH
TETH
YODH
KAPH
verses.text:
My eyes have failed with tears;
my inner parts churn.
My liver is poured out to the ground
over the destruction of the daughter of my people,
when child and infant faint in the streets of the city.

verses.heading: LAMEDH
verses.text:
To their mothers they say,
“Where is grain and wine?”
when they faint like the slain in the streets of the city,
when their life is poured out in the lap of their mothers.

verses.heading: MEM
verses.text:
What can I testify to you?
To what can I compare you, O daughter of Jerusalem?
To what can I liken you,
that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion?
For your brokenness is as great as the sea;
who can heal you?

verses.heading: NUN
verses.text:
Your prophets have seen for you falsehood and worthlessness,
and they did not expose your iniquity to restore your fortunes.
But they have seen for you oracles of falsehood and enticement.

verses.heading: SAMEKH
verses.text:
All those passing along the road clap their hands at you.
They hiss and shake their heads at the daughter of Jerusalem:
“Is this the city that they called ‘the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth’?”

verses.heading: AYIN
PE
TSADHE
verses.text:
Their heart cried out to the Lord.
O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears flow down like a river day and night!
Do not give yourself relief;
do not let the daughter of your eye rest.

verses.heading: QOPH
verses.text:
Arise, cry out in the night,
at the beginning of the night watches!
Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord.
Lift up your hands to him for the life of your children,
who are fainting with hunger at the head of every street.

verses.heading: RESH
verses.text:
See, O Yahweh, and look!
To whom have you dealt thus?
Should women eat their fruit, children of their nursing?
Should priest and prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

verses.heading: SIN
TAW
verses.text:
You have summoned, as on a day of an appointed festival, my terrors from all around,
and there was not on the day of the anger of Yahweh an escapee or a survivor.
Those whom I carried and multiplied, my enemy has consumed them.

verses.heading: ALEPH
verses.text:
I am the man seeing affliction
by the rod of his wrath.

He drove me and made me walk
in darkness and not light.

Surely against me he turns;
he turns his hand all the day.

verses.heading: BETH
verses.text:
He wore out my flesh and my skin;
he shattered my bones.

He built against me
and surrounded me with poison and hardship.

In dark places he made me dwell,
like the dead of long ago.

verses.heading: GIMEL
verses.text:
He walled me in, and I cannot go out;
he made my chains heavy.

Even when I cry out and call for help,
he shuts out my prayer.

He walled up my ways with hewn stone;
my paths he has made crooked.

verses.heading: DALETH
verses.text:
He is a bear lying in ambush to me,
a lion in hiding places.

He bent his bow
and set me up like a target for the arrow.

verses.heading: HE
verses.text:
He caused to enter into my kidneys
the sons of his quiver.

I became a laughingstock to all my people,
their mocking song all the day.

He filled me with bitter herbs;
he saturated me with wormwood.

verses.heading: WAW
verses.text:
And he made my teeth grind on gravel;
he pressed me down in the ashes.

And my soul was deprived of peace;
I have forgotten good.

And I said, “My endurance has perished,
and my hope from Yahweh.”

verses.heading: ZAYIN
verses.text:
Remember my affliction and my wandering,
the wormwood and the poison.

Remembering, it remembers,
and my soul bows down upon me.

This I bring back to my heart;
therefore I will hope.

verses.heading: HETH
verses.text:
The covenant faithfulness of Yahweh—for we have not perished,
for his compassions have not come to an end.

They are new in the mornings;
great is your faithfulness.

“Yahweh is my portion,” my soul said;
therefore I will hope in him.

verses.heading: TETH
verses.text:
Yahweh is good to the ones waiting for him,
to the soul that seeks him.

It is good to wait and be silent
for the salvation of Yahweh.

It is good for a man
that he bears a yoke in his youth.

verses.heading: YODH
verses.text:
Let him sit alone and be silent,
for he has laid it upon him.

Let him put his mouth in the dust;
perhaps there is hope.

Let him give his cheek to the one striking him;
let people fill him with reproach.

verses.heading: KAPH
verses.text: For the Lord will not reject forever.

For though he causes grief,
he will have compassion according to the abundance of his covenant faithfulness.

For he does not afflict from his heart,
or grieve the sons of man.

verses.heading: LAMEDH
verses.text:
To crush under his feet
all the prisoners of the earth,

to turn aside the justice of a man
before the face of the Most High,

to pervert a man in his dispute—
the Lord does not see it.

verses.heading: MEM
verses.text:
Who is this who spoke and it came to be?
Did the Lord not command it?

From the mouth of the Most High
do not the evil things and the good go forth?

Why should a living man complain,
a man about his sins?

verses.heading: NUN
verses.text:
Let us search our ways and examine them,
and let us return to Yahweh.

Let us lift up our hearts with our hands
to God in the heavens.

We, we have transgressed and rebelled;
you have not forgiven.

verses.heading: SAMEKH
verses.text:
You covered yourself in nose and pursued us;
you killed; you did not show pity.

You covered yourself in a cloud,
from a prayer passing through.

Offscouring and refuse you make us
in the midst of the peoples.

verses.heading: AYIN
verses.text:
All our enemies
opened their mouth against us.

Terror and the pit have come to us,
the desolation and the destruction.

Streams of water go down from my eye,
over the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.heading: PE
verses.text:
My eye pours out and does not cease,
without stopping,

until he looks down
and Yahweh sees from the heavens.

My eye brings grief to my soul
because of all the daughters of my city.

verses.heading: TSADHE
verses.text:
Hunting, they hunted me like a bird,
my enemies without cause.

They silenced my life in the pit
and cast a stone against me.

Waters flowed over my head;
I said, “I am cut off.”

verses.heading: QOPH
verses.text:
I called on your name, Yahweh,
from the pit of the depths.

You heard my voice;
do not hide your ear to my relief, to my cry for help.

You drew near on the day I called on you;
you said, “Do not fear.”

verses.heading: RESH
verses.text:
Lord, you pleaded the cases of my soul;
you redeemed my life.

You have seen, Yahweh, my wrong;
judge my case.

You have seen all their vengeance,
all their plans against me.

verses.heading: SIN
verses.text:
You have heard their reproach, Yahweh,
all their plans against me,

the lips of those rising against me and their muttering
against me all the day.

Look at their sitting and their rising;
I am their mocking song.

verses.heading: TAW
verses.text:
You will return to them recompense, Yahweh,
according to the work of their hands.

You will give them a covering of heart;
your curse will be on them.

You will pursue in nose and destroy them
from under the heavens of Yahweh.

verses.heading: ALEPH
verses.text:
How the gold is tarnished;
people have changed the good fine gold.
The stones of holiness are poured out
at the head of every street.

verses.heading: BETH
verses.text:
The precious sons of Zion,
weighed against fine gold,
how they are regarded as jars of clay,
the work of the hands of a potter!

verses.heading: GIMEL
verses.text:
Even jackals offer the breast;
they nurse their young.
But the daughter of my people has become cruel,
like ostriches in the wilderness.

verses.heading: DALETH
verses.text:
The tongue of the nursing infant sticks
to the roof of his mouth with thirst.
Children ask for bread;
there is no one breaking it for them.

verses.heading: HE
verses.text:
The ones eating delicacies
are desolate in the streets.
The ones reared on scarlet
embrace garbage heaps.

verses.heading: WAW
verses.text:
And the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater
than the sin of Sodom,
which was overthrown as in a moment,
and hands did not tremble for her.

verses.heading: ZAYIN
HETH
TETH
verses.text:
Better were the slain of the sword
than the slain of hunger,
for they waste away,
pierced for lack of the fruits of the field.

verses.heading: YODH
verses.text:
The hands of compassionate women
boiled their children;
they became food for them
in the breaking of the daughter of my people.

verses.heading: KAPH
verses.text:
Yahweh brought to completion his wrath;
he poured out the burning of his nose.
And he kindled a fire in Zion,
and it consumed her foundations.

verses.heading: LAMEDH
verses.text:
The kings of the earth did not believe,
nor any of the dwellers of the world,
that an adversary and an enemy
would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.heading: MEM
verses.text:
Because of the sins of her prophets,
the iniquities of her priests,
the ones pouring out
the blood of the righteous in her midst.

verses.heading: NUN
verses.text:
They wandered blind in the streets;
they were defiled with blood,
so that none were able
to touch their garments.

verses.heading: SAMEKH
verses.text:
“Turn aside! Unclean!” they called to them.
“Turn aside! Turn aside! Do not touch!”
For they fled,
and they also wandered.
They said among the nations,
“They shall not continue to sojourn.”

verses.heading: AYIN
verses.text:
The face of Yahweh divided them;
he will not continue to look at them.
The face of the priests they did not lift up,
and the elders they did not show grace.

verses.heading: PE
verses.text:
Our eyes still ended looking for
our help—a vapor.
In our watching, we watched for
a nation that does not save.

verses.heading: TSADHE
verses.text:
They hunted our steps
from walking in our open places.
Our end drew near;
our days are full,
for our end had come.

verses.heading: QOPH
verses.text:
Our pursuers were swifter
than the eagles of the heavens.
On the mountains they chased us;
in the wilderness they lay in wait for us.

verses.heading: RESH
verses.text:
The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh,
was captured in their pits,
of whom we said,
“In his shadow we will live among the nations.”

verses.heading: SIN
verses.text:
Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom,
dweller in the land of Uz.
Also to you the cup will pass;
you will become drunk and will make yourself naked.

verses.heading: TAW

verses.text:
Remember, Yahweh, what has happened to us;
look and see our reproach.

Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers,
our houses to foreigners.

Our water we drink for silver;
our wood comes at a price.

We are pursued on our necks;
we are weary, and rest is not given to us.

We have given a hand to Egypt,
to Assyria, to be satisfied with bread.

Our fathers sinned;
they are no more, and we, we bear their iniquities.

Servants rule over us;
there is no one tearing us away from their hand.

At our lives we bring in our bread,
from the face of the sword of the wilderness.

Our skin grows hot like an oven,
from the face of the burning heat of famine.

They violate women in Zion,
virgins in the cities of Judah.

Princes are hung by their hands;
the faces of elders are not honored.

Young men carry a grinding stone,
and boys stumble under wood.

Elders have ceased from the gate,
young men from their music.

The joy of our heart has ceased;
our dancing has turned to mourning.

The crown of our head has fallen.
Woe now to us, for we have sinned!

On account of this, our heart has become sick;
on account of these things, our eyes have grown dim.

On account of Mount Zion, which is desolate,
foxes walk on it.

You, Yahweh, sit forever;
your throne is to generation and generation.

Why do you forget us forever,
why do you forsake us for the length of days?

Return us to yourself, Yahweh, and let us return;
renew our days as of old.

For have you rejecting, rejected us?
Have you been angry against us beyond measure?
